page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top right. No marginal notes. A catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: Probatio III. Ex textu ver.13: Quia simulavit: & alios simulatione seduxit.
Declaretur & ostendatur: simulationem non fuisse occultationem consilii officiosi: sed osten-sionem falsæ opinionis: I. de necessitate Iuda-ismi ad salutem. II. de illicito convictu cum gentibus.
Amplificetur ab effectu perniciofo in Iudæis & gentibus.

Subiiciatur maior: Talem simulationem haud dubiè peccatum esse: confirmetur testimonio Ciceronis ex Lælio: Simulatio tum omnium rerum est vitiosa (tollit enim iudicium veri) tum amicitia repugnat maxime.
Probatio IV. ex ver.14: Quia non incessit recte pede veritatis.

Declaretur, fuisse claudicationem non in do-ctrina ipsa, sed in πράξει[?] doctrinę: & ostendatur, non tantum opinione gentium, sed revera, & Pauli judicio Petrum claudicasse: ex textu: Cum ego vidissem, &c.
Hic inferatur argumentum Augustini contra Hieronymum: aut Petrum revera claudicasse, aut Paulum mentiri.

Minor sit negatio posterioris, & confirmetur: 1. ex ver.20.c.1: In iis quæ scribo vobis, ecce coram Deo non mentior. 2. Ex thesi: quia nullum ne of-ficiosum quidem mendacium scriptoribus sacris est attribuendum.
Hæc nonnihil elaboretur ab autho-ritate Scripturæ S: à discrimine Scriptorum Ca-nonicorum & Ecclesiasticorum: & à periculo di-versæ sententiæ.

page.notes: The Greek word after "in" (printed as "πράξει") is hard to read at this scan resolution and is marked [?]. The roman numerals "I." and "II." and "IV." and "III." are read from the printed "1", "11", "1 v." and "1 1 1" forms. The long s is transcribed as s throughout, and "ss" printed as "ff"-like forms is read as "ss". The page number is read as 111. The catchword "Clau-" is the hyphenated start of the next page's first word.
